description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Amend the Civil Aviation (Charges for the use of Aerodromes) Regulations - 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010, specifically amending the Civil Aviation (Charges for the Use of Aerodromes) Regulations 2022. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - creating and modifying statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for aviation charges - rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
